orientation_convention: Square 53.34 board; USB micro-B (J1) mates from the v=0 edge [citation: RP2040 Test.kicad_pcb footprint ZX62DB5PA830 at v 1.96..6.94]. Dual 2x18 headers J3 (u-min edge) and J4 (u-max edge) take jumpers from both long sides [citation: extracted footprint bboxes]. No display or user-facing readout; board is a dev board — held either way up, USB edge is 'bottom' for cabling.
user_facing_features: USB micro-B opening in the v=0 wall; jumper-exit relief windows over both 2x18 header bands in the u walls; 4 M2.5 screws from the lid side into bosses.
